observations: The top is unchanged: Steal An Egg (92 days) leads ahead of Brookhaven, 99 Nights in the Forest, +1 Speed Keyboard Escape, Murder Mystery 2 and RIVALS.
Ragdoll Reality (12 days) is the biggest riser at +43, followed by +1 Dance Battle Evolution +30, Ride A Pet +28, Solve The Cube +17 and Violence District +16.
Eleven games entered, including Dead Rails, Dubai RP, Adopt Your Animal! (16 days), Kick a Lucky Block, RoWorld (29 days) and BedWars.
Young games keep falling (Sarab -27, Fix My Phone! -13, Turbo Soccer -12) along with Flee the Facility -25 after its Hollow-driven jump.
The age pattern stays U-shaped: 0–14 days at the 92nd median percentile, 15–122 days at 26–48, and games past a year at 61.
patterns: Games left more than about 9 days without an update consistently stay fewer days on the chart (r=-0.59 at the split), the strongest page-level lever here.
Higher product and pass prices tend to go with longer presence (median product above 472 R$ r=+0.46; median pass above 77 R$ r=+0.46), with age as a confounder.
combat_pvp (70), racing_driving (67), steal_defend_base (64) and roleplay_social (62) lead loops by median percentile; incremental_plus1 (31), obby (31) and wave survival (29) trail.
A high favorite rate per visit goes with lower positions, a lifecycle marker of huge evergreens rather than something to aim for.

outliers.name: Ragdoll Reality 🩸
outliers.note: At 12 days it climbed 43 places, against the mid-life trough for young games; a fresh physics-sandbox novelty appears to carry it.

outliers.name: Flee the Facility
outliers.note: A 9-year-old game that rose on The Hollow event and now gave back 25 places, suggesting event lifts fade quickly once the spotlight moves.

observations: Donation hubs (Summer Donations, Simple DONATIONS, Donation Central) again lead efficiency, followed by Elemental Dungeons, Spin a KPOP Idol and newcomer-to-the-top RIFLE DUELS (71 days, no passes).
Efficiency still rises with age: 33rd median percentile at 15–42 days, 40 at 43–84, 52 at 85–122 and 60 past a year (H-te-001 at 80%).
Steel Fighters rose +281, Criminality +161, Hide From The Hulk +160, Jujutsu Infinite +156 after its Halloween event and Candy Kingdom Defense +155 at 26 days.
Thirty-three games entered, including Carolina Leaners, Marvel Omega, Bey Rivals, Ragdoll Reality, Rebirth Champions: Ultimate and REDLINER; Shonen Unleashed -169 and Steal Animal Egg -166 fell.
patterns: A median developer product price above 79 R$ consistently goes with higher efficiency (r=+0.44 at the split; H-te-005 at 81%).
RPGs (r=+0.48) and roleplay loops (r=+0.30) consistently earn more per player; Survival (r=-0.30), Simulation (r=-0.20) and solo loops (r=-0.24) earn less.

More passes (above 7, r=+0.26), pricier passes, bigger servers, longer descriptions and higher complexity all go with efficiency, with game age as a shared confounder; the pass count is proposed as a hypothesis.
'Egg' (r=-0.70) and 'Steal' (r=-0.40) in titles go with the lowest efficiency, and steal_defend_base sits at the 19th median percentile among loops.

outliers.name: RIFLE DUELS
outliers.note: No game passes and a 77% like ratio, yet among the most efficient; premium currency and skin trading carry spending, as in other duel shooters.

outliers.name: [🎃] Fake an Egg
outliers.note: On all four charts at 21 days but among the weakest earners per player, consistent with steal/egg templates buying reach rather than revenue.

observations: A Long Flight (25 days) leads momentum at +26, followed by It Hears The Water +21, Rally Panic! +19, +1 Upgrade Per Kill +15 and Makeup All Stars +13.
Youngest games carry the most momentum: 0–14 days at the 83rd median percentile, 15–42 at 55, 43–84 at 45 and 85–122 at 27.
Twelve games entered, including Dead Rails, Demonology, Realistic Ragdoll Engine (13 days), PINKIE PROMISE and Throw Food For Animals; Evade, Chop A Forest and Drive World fell off.
Keyboard Bridge Wars -28, AOONI Nightmare -21 and Create a Robot Fighter -17 fell; job sims remain the weakest loop (8th median percentile).
patterns: Shorter titles consistently go with higher positions within age bands (within-age -0.39; H-tt-037 at 67%).

Revive products (within-age +0.31; H-tt-036 at 64%) and incremental mechanics (H-tt-034 at 60%) tend to go with momentum, while luck products (-0.38) and character-art thumbnails (-0.37) go against it.
Storage and slot passes go with lower positions (r=-0.40, 11 games), proposed as a hypothesis; a title event tag goes with higher positions (+0.30).
story_adventure (86), sandbox_physics (77), horror_escape (74) and wave survival (73) lead by median percentile, though each from only 3–5 games.

outliers.name: A Long Flight [SANDBOX]
outliers.note: A 73% like ratio, yet the fastest climber; an A Dusty Trip-style journey with a plane is a familiar hook in a new skin.

outliers.name: [🎃] +1 Upgrade Per Kill
outliers.note: A 47% like ratio, yet among the best on momentum; the +1 incremental hook appears to outweigh poor reception.

observations: DONT SPLASH (8 days) leads, ahead of Ragdoll Reality, The Hollow, Bike Universe, Backseat Rally and Cat Battles.
Realistic Ragdoll Engine rose +37, Airport Security (Anomaly) +32, Catch a Plane! +30, Apple iPad Original +27 and My Bus +25; Where Is Fahd? fell 25.
Twelve games entered, including roll the world, UNDERTALE Fight!, Cook the Chicken, Fart Together, Harvest It All and ROOM 13, while RoWorld and +1 Dance Battle Evolution moved on.
The youngest band leads (0–14 days at the 60th percentile) but the 43–84 day band sits higher still (65) on only 7 games.
patterns: Recent and frequent updates consistently go with higher positions (H-uc-012 at 74%; several updates a week, H-uc-015 at 69%).
'Play with your friends' co-op pitches consistently rank lower (within-age -0.43; H-uc-013 at 70%), and clan or team systems also go with lower positions (-0.42), proposed as a hypothesis.
Physics sandboxes (+0.43) and everyday-life roleplay (within-age +0.44) go with higher positions; the sandbox signal is proposed as a hypothesis alongside the ragdoll wave.
More than about 4 page images goes with lower positions (-0.34 at the split), the opposite of the Top Trending idea, proposed for testing.

outliers.name: PERIPHERAL (BETA)
outliers.note: A polished procedural horror game with revives and a creature-gaze mechanic, yet among the weakest; a single page image and a co-op pitch may hold it back.

outliers.name: Cat Battles 🐾
outliers.note: Among the best despite a 73% like ratio and 256 developer products, against both the like-ratio and launch-monetization patterns.

summary: Ragdoll physics keeps spreading: Ragdoll Reality rose on Most Popular and holds near the top of Up-and-Coming and Top Trending, and Realistic Ragdoll Engine climbed onto both breakout charts.
Games pull players first and monetize later: the youngest games lead Top Trending and Up-and-Coming while Top Earning efficiency climbs from the 33rd percentile at 15–42 days to the 60th past a year.
Steal/egg templates keep buying reach without revenue: Fake an Egg is on all four charts but among the weakest earners, and 'Egg' and 'Steal' titles carry the lowest efficiency.

Fandom fan games (UNDERTALE Fight!, Bey Rivals, Omni Heroes, Candy Kingdom Defense, My Chiikawa Restaurant) entered Up-and-Coming and Top Earning today, a pattern to watch alongside Halloween and The Hollow as seasonal confounders.
progressions: tt→mp remains the most common transition (101 entries, median 2 days), followed by uc→tt (98, 2 days).
te→tt (66, 8 days), uc→te (66, 4 days), tt→te (65, 4 days) and uc→mp (64, 4 days) show breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
